title: Xi'an
subtitle: Independent
description: Athletic, agile and a fan of wielding double blades, Xi'an was part of a team of criminals assembled by Ranzar Malk to rescue her twin brother, Qin, from a New Republic prison transport. In order to complete the job, she worked with the Mandalorian, a Devaronian named Burg, and ex-imperial Migs Mayfeld. But when the group turned on Mando, he turned on them and they were all left in the prison.
